spec_match.rationale: Mirrors 'only exists on valid interest sources' across eight specimens (button, link with/without href, disabled, span, input type=button, dangling id, no interestfor) and the following-sibling ordering after ::after.

interactive.rationale: Re-measure button and a live remove/restore interestfor toggle on row 1; every row reports computed content, generated box and hit-test result.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the nine-host table (eight specimens plus the ordering row), the detection gotcha and the ::after ordering.

edge_cases.rationale: Dangling id, dynamic removal, disabled and href-less cases all observed: with the flag only rows 1–2 generate (+50px) and hit-test returns the originating element; removal drops row 1 to no box.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus, CSS Pseudo 4 §4.4 and the HTML interactive-elements section.

conformance.rationale: Suite covers disabled, no-href, non-interactive, dynamic removal and hit-testing contracts.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome 153 + flag: 2 of 8 generated, 8 of 8 match expectation; without flag 0 of 8 with explicit fallback note; console clean on desktop and mobile.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the probe and the valid-sources-only contract on Re-measure, with the fallback state in details.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; row cards ivory with charcoal/black text.

accessibility.rationale: Native radios/checkboxes/buttons with labels and ≥44px rows; readouts are role=status/log live regions. Per spec the ⓘ is not focusable and not in the accessibility tree (confirmed: Tab skips it; CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree shows no node for it); keyboard users reach the same content by focusing the host. The ordering row is a visual-only check (labelled as such) because pseudo-element boxes cannot be measured individually.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 (touch) or 1280×800, flag on and off; controls stack; screenshots read. Note: headless touch emulation did not make (any-pointer: coarse) match, so the coarse-gated branch was exercised only via its 'media query false' path.

openQuestions.title: Add SVG <a href> and <area href> specimens
openQuestions.detail: The explainer lists SVG <a href> and <area href> as interest sources; pseudo-element boxes do not render inside SVG, and <area> needs an image map. Decide how to present these honestly.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment; verification used headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright with and without --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, plus Read screenshots. Repeat with DevTools MCP and inspect the accessibility tree (project rule 7b).

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use popover=hint targets positioned via the implicit anchor with position-area; gate inset:auto/margin:0 inside @supports (position-area: …) so browsers without anchor positioning keep centred placement; never move focus into the hint.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All hint popovers use position-area inside @supports(position-area: block-end) with position-try-fallbacks; no focus is moved on interest.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless Chrome 153 desktop+mobile: popovers open adjacent to their invoker; no horizontal overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: coarse pointer media query touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep touch targets at least 44px and adapt controls to pointer type.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The ⓘ pseudo-element and every control are ≥44px; the coarse-pointer gate follows the spec's @media (any-pointer: coarse) example.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Verification script reported no button/input under 44px tall at 360×740 and 1280×800.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo controls no horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use auto-fit grids with min(100%, …) tracks and wrap flex rows so nothing overflows narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Control fieldsets and card grids use repeat(auto-fit|auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, Nrem), 1fr)); readouts use overflow-wrap:anywhere.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: scrollWidth === innerWidth at 360 and 1280 for every page, flag on and off.

summary: Inspection tool proves computed content ≠ rendered box; validity matrix matches the spec with the flag.
